d: Long champagne-blonde hair flows past the shoulders with a side-parted fringe and a small braid on one side. The eyes are a bright cyan blue with a calm, confident expression on a face reflecting a young adult maturity. The build is slender with a curved silhouette, dressed in a light blue blazer with yellow trim over a low-cut white blouse, a matching light blue mini-skirt with yellow side stripes, and sheer black tights. Accessories include a yellow neckerchief, a black belt with a gold star buckle, black high-heeled shoes with yellow bows, and a black tactical knife strapped to the left thigh.
